author: Matthew Adam
title: Josh Bell clubs two homers, drives in three vs. Yankees
desc: Josh Bell went 3-for-5 in an 11-4 win over the Yankees with two home runs, a double, two runs scored, three RBI, and one strikeout.
impact: Bell hit a solo homer in the seventh and a two-run shot in the eighth inning. After Saturday's win, Bell is batting .250 with 13 home runs, 59 RBI, 45 runs scored, one stolen base, a .321 wOBA, and a .287 BABIP across 87 games. He's hitting .280 with four homers and eight RBI across his past seven contests.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Trevor Larnach leaves the yard as Twins thump Yankees
desc: Trevor Larnach went 2-for-3 in an 11-4 win over the Yankees with a home run, two runs scored, one RBI, and two walks.
impact: Larnach's solo shot in the fourth inning gave the Twins a 6-0 lead. Through 74 games, Larnach is batting .292 with six home runs, 30 RBI, 41 runs scored, two steals, a .365 wOBA, and a .344 BABIP. He's been on fire of late, hitting .421 with three homers and 13 RBI over his past 15 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Kody Clemens clubs homer, drives in three vs. Yankees
desc: Kody Clemens went 2-for-4 in Saturday's 11-4 win over the Yankees with a home run, two runs scored, three RBI, a walk, and a strikeout.
impact: After Saturday's win over the Yankees, Clemens is slashing .248/.311/.500 with 16 home runs, 42 RBI, 42 runs scored, and six stolen bases across 76 games. He's been hot of late, hitting .310 with four homers and 10 RBI over his past seven games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Austin Martin steals a base in win
desc: Austin Martin stole a base and scored a run in an 11-4 win over the Yankees on Saturday.
impact: Martin pinch-ran for Trevor Larnach and wound up coming around to score. The veteran is hitting .241 with two homers, 31 runs, 17 RBI, and nine steals across 220 at-bats this season.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Zebby Matthews labors with walks despite Twins' win
desc: Zebby Matthews allowed four earned runs on three hits and four walks while striking out five over 4.2 innings in Saturday's 11-4 win over the Yankees.
impact: Matthews left his start early after suffering a foot laceration, but the right-hander is not expected to miss his next start. After the outing, he now has a 4.43 ERA and 1.16 WHIP with a 4-5 record through 10 starts.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Austin Hedges supplies rare pop in 3-1 loss to White Sox
desc: Austin Hedges went 2-for-3 in a 3-1 loss to the White Sox with a home run, one run scored, and one RBI.
impact: His solo homer in the fifth inning was the only run the Guardians could muster. After Saturday's loss, Hedges is batting .273 with three home runs, 14 RBI, 16 runs scored, and one stolen base across 44 games. He's been hot of late, hitting .421 with two homers and five RBI over his past seven games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Kahlil Watson swipes two bags despite another hitless night
desc: Kahlil Watson went 0-for-4 in a 3-1 loss to the White Sox on Saturday with two stolen bases and three strikeouts.
impact: Watson kept the fantasy lights on with his legs, but the bat was nowhere to be found in Saturday's loss. Watson is batting .250 with one home run, nine RBI, and four stolen bases through 16 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Brayan Rocchio swipes bag in loss to White Sox
desc: Brayan Rocchio went 2-for-4 in a 3-1 loss to the White Sox on Saturday with one stolen base and one strikeout.
impact: Rocchio was also caught stealing once. After Saturday's loss, Rocchio is batting .273 with six home runs, 37 RBI, and 15 stolen bases across 87 games. He's been hot of late, hitting .320 with one homer, three RBI, and three steals across his past seven games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Parker Messick labors through five in 3-1 loss
desc: Parker Messick allowed one earned run on five hits and three walks while striking out three over five innings in Saturday's 3-1 loss to the White Sox.
impact: Messick was selected for his first All-Star appearance earlier in the day. He now carries a 2.80 ERA and 1.08 WHIP with a 7-5 record through 18 starts, alongside a 9.3 K/9 and 3.41 K:BB. Messick's last start before the All-Star break will be Friday against the Marlins.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Angel Martinez (foot) takes batting practice Saturday
desc: Angel Martinez took batting practice on Saturday.
impact: Martinez suffered a non-displaced fracture in his left foot on June 13. He resumed hitting off a tee in late June and has since progressed to batting practice. While he continues to make encouraging progress, fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to return until late July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Dane Myers (shoulder) receives injection Saturday
desc: Dane Myers received an injection in his AC joint on Saturday.
impact: Myers suffered a left shoulder contusion on June 29 against the Milwaukee Brewers after crashing into the outfield wall while making a running catch. He received an injection in his AC joint on Saturday and is expected to rest for a few days before the Cincinnati Reds determine the next step in his recovery. He remains without a timetable for his return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Matt Shaw (hand) will not return before All-Star break
desc: Chicago Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Matt Shaw will not return before the All-Star break.
impact: Shaw has been sidelined since June 29 due to a left hand sprain. He's expected to be re-evaluated next week to determine next steps and receive a clearer timeline for his return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Shea Langeliers (thumb) hopeful to return Tuesday
desc: The Athletics are hopeful Shea Langeliers can return to the lineup for Tuesday's series opener against the Tigers.
impact: Langeliers suffered a left thumb contusion in Friday's game against the Marlins while receiving a pitch in the fifth inning and eventually exited the game in the fourth inning. It appears he'll avoid a stint on the injured list and could return to the lineup Tuesday after a few days off. While he's sidelined, Jonah Heim will continue to start behind the plate.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Shota Imanaga picks up loss Saturday
desc: Shota Imanaga allowed two runs on four hits and three walks while striking out eight across 4.2 innings in Saturday's 3-0 loss to the St. Louis Cardinals.
impact: Imanaga gave up a leadoff home run to JJ Wetherholt to start the game, but settled down and allowed just an RBI single in the third inning. He showcased his upside in this one, recording eight strikeouts,  his most since May 7, when he recorded 10 against the Cincinnati Reds. He owns a 4.28 ERA and 1.10 WHIP with 100 strikeouts in 103 innings this season. He'll look to deliver fantasy managers another solid outing on Friday against the Reds.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Sandy Alcantara fans eight hitters in win Saturday
desc: Sandy Alcantara allowed one run on six hits and one walk while striking out eight across eight innings in Saturday's 7-2 win over the Athletics.
impact: After walking five batters and giving up five runs in his previous start at Coors Field, Alcantara delivered a huge bounce-back performance, limiting the free passes and pitching eight innings on 100 pitches. The only run he gave up came in the seventh inning, after two singles set up a Jeff McNeil sacrifice fly. He owns a 4.00 ERA and 1.25 WHIP with 92 strikeouts across 123.2 innings this season. His next scheduled start is on Friday against the Cleveland Guardians.
